purpose: Collect four new mixed-controller teacher trajectories for later bounded BC.
stage_scope: Two new development seeds, round2, both seats, 4 official games and 4 primary 719-step replays; fixed label sampling and admission.
future_fit_precommitment: If admitted, later combine old sealed and new data with the unmodified trainer for one 128-update fit; no automatic fit in this stage.
stop_conditions: Any identity, official execution, replay, probe, cleanup, resource or sample-admission failure stops without retry or replacement.
boundaries: No old cache reads, new training, test games, PPO, default Bot or official engine changes; raw traces and replay remain local.
provenance: Independent subagent advice and review, not WebChat.
